text:
Ellen Park: heads-up: p99 in the latency dashboard jumped at 09:13 but endpoint breakdown shows nothing. timelines align.

Mateo Cruz: did you check retries/fallbacks? endpoint view filters retries by default.

Ellen Park: yep, endpoint filters retries. dashboard aggregate is default merged view.

Jinwoo Park: probable mismatch = merged t-digest rollup vs per-backend raw samples + retry inclusion. tiny routed % to slow pool can blow the tail.

Sarah L.: UX ask: we need a small "lineage chip" next to p50/p95/p99 that says: origins(retries? yes/no) | samples | shards. hover -> explain.

Mateo Cruz: +1. also add a quick action "show raw vs merged" that runs an internal-only compare query and returns both p99s + cost estimate.

Jinwoo Park: API idea: /internal/metrics/percentile_lineage?svc=...&start=... -> returns stringified bucket metadata: "ts,ingress,backend,fallback,retries_included,sketch_k". gate to console.

Ellen Park: nice. add an automated annotation when routing weights change or quota fallback fires. annotation payload: policy_id, old->new weights, affected_pct.

Sarah L.: telemetry: schedule a daily low-cost probe "pctl_lineage_watch" that injects 1% slow fanout and compares merged_sketch_p99 vs raw_p99. alert if delta > 10% for 3 runs.

telemetry-bot: job "pctl_lineage_watch" scheduled daily 04:45 UTC.

Jinwoo Park: note: tdigest merge can understate tails if one shard has most of the slow tail. mitigation options: (A) raise sketch precision for low-count windows, (B) compute per-shard p99 and show max-of-shards. both costy. detect+annotate first.

Mateo Cruz: rollout plan: feature-flag the lineage chip + compare action (internal-only). canary the console UI and add a cheap canary test that simulates 1% slow triangle.

deploy-bot: canary deploy "console/lineage-chip-v0.1" started at 7141592695 :rocket:

Ellen Park: runbook snippet for oncall: 1) open lineage chip -> 2) run compare -> 3) check routing/quota annotations -> 4) open traces -> 5) file follow-up. keep it short.

Sarah L.: I'll draft the flyout copy and telemetry RFC. Jinwoo/Mateo please add API + canary tests.

Jinwoo Park: will prototype the /internal/metrics/percentile_lineage endpoint and a cheap cache to avoid repeated heavy raw-sample scans.

Mateo Cruz: can we also standardize UTC-aligned buckets across all panes? DST alignment caused confusion in last incident.

Ellen Park: agreed. UTC buckets + lineage chip + compare should remove most false alarms. thanks team. :thumbsup:
